newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials lower at open, IBM weak.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials lower at open, IBM weak.

text.p: Wall Street stocks followed through on the previous session's weakness to open lower on Wednesday.
Weakness in IBM shares put pressure on the Dow in early trading, while soft bonds offered little support.
The Dow industrials was down 14 at 6,048 at the start. The NASDAQ Index was down one at 1,219 and the S&P Index down one at 705.
The long bond was down 1/32 to yield 6.86 percent.
